Location: Bengaluru, India
Work Schedule: 24x7 Rotational Shifts


About the Role

Join Sabre's Operations Control Center (OCC) team, a critical function that supports Sabre's global infrastructure and technology platforms processing over 85,000 transactions per second. The OCC team serves as the first line of response for operational incidents, proactively monitoring and mitigating potential issues before they impact customers.

As an IT Operations Analyst I, you will work closely with Operations Control Center peers and Service Reliability Engineers to ensure the stability, availability, and performance of Sabre's applications and infrastructure. Training, cross-functional exposure, and knowledge-based operational support will be provided to help you succeed in the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Follow and apply ITIL-based operational processes and procedures.
  • Monitor and support the operational stability of Sabre applications and infrastructure.
  • Respond to alerts and incidents in a timely manner.
  • Initiate and coordinate technical incident bridges through resolution.
  • Perform incident triage and service request support using established knowledge bases.
  • Execute day-to-day operational activities by following documented work instructions and procedures.
  • Adhere to organizational policies, operational directives, and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure service availability and operational excellence.
  • Work in a 24x7 rotational shift environment, including night shifts.

Required Qualifications


Experience

  • 1-2 years of experience in a Command Center, Network Operations Center (NOC), Service Desk, or similar operational support environment.
  • Basic understanding of IT Operations, Incident Management, and Monitoring processes.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as:
    • Splunk
    • Zabbix
    • AppDynamics
    • Google Cloud Console (or similar tools)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent work experience will also be considered.

Preferred Skills

  • Understanding of ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Exposure to cloud and infrastructure monitoring environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and organized during critical incidents.
  • Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and grow.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a team responsible for supporting mission-critical global technology platforms.
  • Gain hands-on experience with enterprise-scale infrastructure and monitoring tools.
  • Work alongside experienced Service Reliability Engineers and Operations professionals.
  • Opportunity to build a strong foundation in IT Operations, Incident Management, and Site Reliability practices.

Base Location: Bangalore

Range of Year Experience - Min Year: 1
Range of Year Experience - Max Year: 3 years
Relevant Experience: Minimum 1 year in End User or Desktop Support

Position Summary
The Service Desk Engineer serves as the primary point of contact for employees seeking technical support and service assistance. This is a call-taking role, with the majority of daily responsibilities focused on handling inbound calls, resolving employee issues, and delivering an exceptional customer experience.
The successful candidate will provide first-level support for incidents, service requests, account access issues, and general technology inquiries while adhering to service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards. This role requires strong communication skills, active listening, problem-solving abilities, and experience working in a fast-paced service desk, call center, or support center environment.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Support Call Handling
  • Serve as the first point of contact for employees contacting the Service Desk.
  • Handle inbound calls as the primary support channel.
  • Deliver professional, courteous, and efficient customer service during every interaction.
  • Utilize active listening skills to understand customer concerns and accurately diagnose issues.
  • Provide first-contact resolution whenever possible.
  • Maintain a positive and customer-focused attitude while managing consecutive calls throughout the workday.
    Incident Request Management
    • Log, categorize, prioritize, and manage incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve Level 1 support issues related to hardware, software, email, collaboration tools, VPN connectivity, password resets, and account access.
    • Escalate complex issues to appropriate support teams while maintaining ownership and communication with end users.
    • Ensure all tickets are documented accurately and updated with relevant troubleshooting steps and resolutions.
    • Follow established support processes, procedures, and escalation guidelines.
      Service Excellence
      • Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), quality targets, and customer satisfaction goals.
      • Manage workload effectively to ensure timely resolution of incidents and requests.
      • Communicate clearly and professionally with employees at all levels of the organization.
      • Provide guidance on self-service resources, knowledge articles, and available support channels.
        Knowledge Management Continuous Improvement
        • Contribute to the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of knowledge base articles and support documentation.
        • Identify recurring issues and recommend opportunities for process improvement.
        • Participate in training activities, testing efforts, and departmental initiatives.
        • Support team objectives and contribute to a collaborative and positive work environment.
          Compliance Security
          • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and security standards.
          • Maintain confidentiality and protect sensitive employee and business information.
          • Follow all data privacy, information security, and compliance requirements.
            Required Qualifications
            • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in a Service Desk, Help Desk, Service Center, Contact Center, Call Center, or Customer Support environment.
            • Proven experience handling a high volume of inbound customer or employee support calls.
            • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
            • Demonstrated ability to provide exceptional customer service in a fast-paced environment.
            • Experience using ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Remedy, or equivalent platforms.
            • Ability to multitask and navigate multiple applications while assisting customers over the phone.
            • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
            • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
              Preferred Qualifications
              • Experience supporting enterprise IT environments.
              • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure AD, and VPN support.
              • Understanding of ITIL Incident and Request Management processes.
              • Experience working with workforce management metrics in a service center environment.
              • ITIL Foundation Certification or equivalent certification.
                Key Competencies
                • Customer Focus
                • Active Listening
                • Communication Skills
                • Problem Solving
                • Attention to Detail
                • Time Management
                • Team Collaboration
                • Accountability
                • Adaptability

Technical Support Engineer Associate
This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Aruba, an HPE Company, is a leading provider of next-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some of the largest companies in the world modernise their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the Intelligent Edge and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us to redefine what is next for you.
What you ll do:
Responsibilities:
  • Designs portions of engineering solutions utilizing multiple engineering disciplines for products, systems, software, and solutions based on established engineering principles and in accordance with provided specifications and requirements
  • Implements established test plans for existing designs, including validation of mechanical, electrical, software, and other engineering specifications and requirements.
  • Develops understanding of and relationship with internal and outsourced development partners on engineering design and development.
  • Participates as a member of project team of other engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for low to moderately- complex products.
What you need to bring:
Education and Experience Required:
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or other Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • Typically 0-2 years experience.
Knowledge and Skills:
  • Experience or understanding of appropriate engineering design tools and software packages.
  • Good analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Basic understanding of material properties and hardware and electrical component design.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.

Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer s and partner s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What Were Looking For:

Responsible for monitoring cloud environments, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring timely escalation of events to maintain system health and performance. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to incident management in a 24x7x365 operational environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Diligently observe and interpret cloud monitoring dashboards and alerts
- Resolve basic issues; escalate urgent and complex issues. Know the difference
- Coordinate with internal departments and sometimes with customers
- Be aware of customer SLA s and escalate issues if cases are taking too long to resolve
- Document all troubleshooting and issue management actions via the electronic case management system
- Schedule resources and arrange work effort to cover weekends and/or on-call shifts to be available to be engaged in response to system-initiated alerts
- Monitoring case backlog to ensure we meet agreed SLAs with customers and internal KPI targets; share regular status reports with stakeholders
- Be able to work in a variety of different shifts, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays to support a 24x7x365 environment. Shifts may fluctuate to meet business and staffing needs

Key Skills and Competencies:
- Experience with Windows, Linux, web services, networking, Data bases, and cloud platforms.
- Understanding of the following monitoring concepts: Infrastructure, systems, and Application health, system availability, latency, performance, and end-to-end monitoring.
- Entry level cloud, network or security certificate from Cisco, Microsoft, AWS, CompTIA, or other well-known vendors.
- Knowledge and experience of SIEM, ELK, PLG, and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes are preferred.
- Cyber Security related Certifications like Security+, SSCP, CCSP, and CEH.
- Knowledge of Markup, query, and scripting languages, including Python, HTML, PromQL, SQL and familiarity with REST API calls, and PowerShell.
- Experience (1+ years) with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge and Event Management.

Minimum Education or Equivalent: Bachelors degree or technical diploma in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

Minimum Work Experience: 2+ years experience working on an operations style team (NOC, SOC, MOC, etc.) and troubleshooting networking, service desk, operations center and/or supporting cloud based Infrastructure

Work Environment: Hybrid

Safety Sensitive Role: No

Travel: Up to 10%

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): No

Must be able to see color: No

Physical Demands:

- Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing

Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

    PepsiCo is seeking a highly motivated and skilled PepsiConnect DevOps Engineer to support and enhance our cloud-native platform capabilities. This role will be responsible for managing Azure infrastructure, source code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes (AKS) environments, and GitOps deployments using ArgoCD. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective platform operations while enabling rapid application delivery through automation and DevOps best practices.
    The position will collaborate closely with development, architecture, security, and operations teams to drive infrastructure modernization, platform standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the PepsiConnect ecosystem. This role is critical in strengthening internal DevOps capabilities and reducing reliance on external vendors while supporting business-critical digital initiatives.

    Responsibilities

    • Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure to support PepsiConnect applications and services.
    • Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, access controls, and release processes using Azure DevOps and Git-based platforms.
    • Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable secure and automated application deployments.
    • Deploy, administer, and support Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters across development, testing, and production environments.
    • Implement and manage GitOps deployment practices using ArgoCD to ensure reliable and auditable releases.
    • Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, ARM, or Bicep templates to automate infrastructure provisioning.
    • Monitor platform health, performance, and availability using cloud-native monitoring and logging tools.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and platform-related issues to ensure operational stability.
    • Drive cloud governance, security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and operational best practices.
    • Analyze Azure resource utilization and implement cost optimization initiatives to improve cloud efficiency.
    • Collaborate with development, architecture, security, and operations teams to support application delivery and platform modernization.
    • Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment standards, and operational procedures.
    • Support incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
    • Promote DevOps best practices, automation, and operational excellence across the organization.

    Qualifications

    • Bachelor''s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
    • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, or Platform Engineering.
    • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
    • 2+ years of experience managing and supporting Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
    • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, branching strategies, and release management.
    • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
    • Hands-on experience with ArgoCD and GitOps deployment methodologies.
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep).
    • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
    • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
    Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Knowledge of cloud security, governance, and compliance best practices.
    • Experience with Azure networking, Application Gateway, Key Vault, and monitoring services.
    • Experience in cloud cost management and optimization.
    • Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
    • Relevant Azure, Kubernetes, or DevOps certifications are a plus.
    Key Competencies
    • Strong ownership and accountability.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment.
    • Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
    • Focus on automation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

    - Diligently observe and interpret cloud monitoring dashboards and alerts

Senior System Engineer - Devops


We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Site Reliability/Infrastructure/ Devops Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will work across AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud platforms, ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our systems. This role involves collaborating with development and operations teams to implement DevOps practices, automate processes, manage Kubernetes environments, and maintain infrastructure that supports our applications and services.


Senior Systems Engineer 

Rapidly growing startup in the health sector and great founding team to work with. We are building the best healthcare startup in the ecosystem to provide affordable medicine by optimizing supply chain and logistics that are based on highly personalized experience. We are funded by best-in-class VCs.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, create, own, and maintain systems and service deployments in cloud and container architecture (AWS, Kubernetes)
  • Continuously improve CI/CD & infrastructure for better reliability, observability, performance & scalability
  • Contributing to important architectural and operational decisions like deployment techniques, monitoring, automation, forming best practices policies, etc.
  • Work closely with engineering leaders and architects from multiple teams
  • Leading incident response and postmortems
  • Develop Infrastructure-as-code artifacts for re-use across the environments
  • Ensure availability, performance, security, and scalability of production systems

Desired Skills:

  • Engineering graduate with 2 - 5 years of experience as a DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Deep understanding of at least one modern Linux distributions and its package management system. Should be comfortable at debugging and configuring operating systems
  • Experience in writing BASH / SHELL scripts. Must be fluent at coding in at least one programming language (Preferably python or golang)
  • Strong hands-on experience with one of the cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.
  • Experience in managing applications on cloud at production scale. Must be familiar with Compute, Load Balancing, Auto Scaling, Databases, Networking and DNS services
  • Should have experience in setting up and administering at least one CI / CD systems like Jenkins, Gitlab CI, Travis
  • Proficiency with Kubernetes concepts such as Pods, Services, Deployments, Statefulsets, volume claims, Helm Charts. Experience with Docker, Docker Compose / Swarm. 
  • Infrastructure automation experience with knowledge of at least a few of these tools: Chef, Puppet, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform, Packer
  • Experience in at least one monitoring / alerting solutions like Prometheus, Zabbix, Nagios, VictoriaMetrics, Icinga or Elastic Stack
  • Understanding of Web and its protocols like HTTP, SSL, TCP, DNS, etc.
  • Strong understanding on System communication and various protocols like ARP, Switches, Routers etc., 
  • Should be proficient in troubleshooting HTTP performance and availability issues 
  • Any experience with managing high scale Kafka, Elasticsearch clusters, self-hosted databases, ArgoCD, Hashicorp Vault, Grafana would be a plus
  • Team player, excellent problem-solving skills and ability to learn new technologies a must

Role & responsibilities

MBS Global is hiring Production / Application Support Engineers for multiple openings with leading global technology clients. If youre the person who keeps critical applications running smoothly and enjoys solving issues under pressure, this role is for you.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide L2/L3 support for business-critical applications and keep them stable
  • Monitor applications, servers and batch jobs; respond to alerts and incidents within SLA
  • Troubleshoot issues using SQL queries, application logs and Unix/Linux commands
  • Manage incidents, problems and change requests through ServiceNow / JIRA following ITIL processes
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and work with development teams on permanent fixes
  • Support deployments, releases and month-end / batch activities
  • Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles and support documentation

What we’re looking for:

  • 1–5 years of experience in Production / Application Support
  • Strong SQL skills (Oracle / SQL Server / MySQL) for data analysis and issue resolution
  • Good hands-on experience with Unix / Linux commands; shell scripting is a plus
  • Understanding of ITIL processes – Incident, Problem and Change Management
  • Experience with ServiceNow, JIRA, or similar ticketing tools
  • Exposure to monitoring tools (Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Grafana) is good to have
  • Experience with batch schedulers like Control-M / Autosys is a plus
  • Willing to work in rotational shifts and provide on-call support when needed
  • Good communication skills for coordinating with business and technical teams

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer s and partner s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. What Were Looking For:

Responsible for monitoring cloud environments, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring timely escalation of events to maintain system health and performance. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to incident management in a 24x7x365 operational environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Diligently observe and interpret cloud monitoring dashboards and alerts
- Resolve basic issues; escalate urgent and complex issues. Know the difference
- Coordinate with internal departments and sometimes with customers
- Be aware of customer SLA s and escalate issues if cases are taking too long to resolve
- Document all troubleshooting and issue management actions via the electronic case management system
- Schedule resources and arrange work effort to cover weekends and/or on-call shifts to be available to be engaged in response to system-initiated alerts
- Monitoring case backlog to ensure we meet agreed SLAs with customers and internal KPI targets; share regular status reports with stakeholders

- Experience with Windows, Linux, web services, networking, Data bases, and cloud platforms.

- Cyber Security related Certifications like Security+, SSCP, CCSP, and CEH.
- Knowledge of Markup, query, and scripting languages, including Python, HTML, PromQL, SQL and familiarity with REST API calls, and PowerShell.
- Experience (1+ years) with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge and Event Management.

- Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing

  • Cloud Operations & Administration
